 SECTIONS IBPS RRB PO Admit Card 2026 released at ibps.in: Check direct link, steps to download, exam dates and important details By Trending Desk , ET Online Last Updated: Nov 09, 2026, 06:01:00 PM IST Rate Story Follow us Share Font Size Abc Small Abc Medium Abc Large Save Print Comment Synopsis Aspiring candidates can easily obtain the IBPS RRB PO 2026 Admit Card from the official website, ibps.in, essential for their exam preparations. The preliminary exam dates are set for November 21 and 22, 2026, followed by the mains on December 20. The admit card features vital information like the candidate's name, test location, and reporting time.
 iStock IBPS RRB PO Admit Card 2026 released at ibps.in: Check direct link, steps to download, exam dates and important details
 The IBPS RRB PO 2026 Admit Card was released on November 9, 2026, by the Institute of Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS). Candidates who have applied for Officer Scale I posts can download their preliminary examination call letters from the official website, ibps.in.
 IBPS RRB PO 2026 Admit Card: Direct Link 
 ibps.in.
 Steps to download IBPS RRB PO 2026 Admit Card 
Candidates can follow the steps below to access and download their IBPS RRB PO Prelims Admit Card 2026:
 Live Events
 1. Visit the official IBPS website at ibps.in.
 2. Navigate to the CRP RRB section available on the homepage.
3. Click on the link titled Online Preliminary Exam Call Letter for CRP RRB-XV Officer Scale-I.
4. Enter your registration number or roll number along with your password or date of birth in the respective fields.
5. Enter the displayed captcha code and click on the login option.
6. The IBPS RRB PO Admit Card 2026 will appear on the screen.
7. Download the call letter and save the PDF for future reference.
8. Take multiple printouts of the admit card to carry to the examination centre.
 IBPS RRB PO Admit Card 2026: Details Mentioned On Hall Ticket 
Candidates are advised to carefully check all the information printed on their IBPS RRB PO Prelims Admit Card 2026 after downloading it. The call letter contains important details related to the candidate and the examination.
The following details are generally mentioned on the admit card:
 Candidate's full name and roll number or user ID
 Registration or application number
 Name of the applied post
 Training dates, reporting time and batch schedule, wherever applicable
 Name and complete postal address of the examination centre
 Candidate's photograph and digital signature
 Date of birth and social category
 Candidate's signature and space for the invigilator's signature
 Important examination instructions and attendance guidelines
 IBPS RRB PO Prelims Exam 2026 Date 
The IBPS RRB PO Preliminary Examination 2026 is scheduled to be conducted on November 21 and 22, 2026. Candidates appearing for the examination should download their admit cards in advance and check their examination date, reporting time and centre details to avoid last-minute confusion.
 IBPS RRB PO Admit Card 2026: Important Details 
The admit card is a compulsory document that carries essential examination-related information, including the candidate's roll number, exam date, shift, reporting time and examination centre address.
 IBPS RRB PO Exam 2026: Important Dates And Timings 
Candidates appearing for the IBPS RRB PO recruitment examination should take note of the following important dates and schedule details:
- Preliminary Examination Dates: November 21 and 22, 2026
- Mains Examination Date: December 20, 2026
- Exact Shift Timings: To be announced.
- Shift-wise Reporting Time: To be announced.
